verdict.rationale: Airwallex Billing documents invoicing that generates invoices with digital payment links across 160+ local payment methods, supports one-time and recurring invoices, and offers hosted billing checkout. That covers sending invoices that customers can pay online. Nothing in the pack mentions automatic payment reminders or dunning for unpaid invoices, so a key part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: automatic invoice reminders/dunning, explicit hosted-invoice-page detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
